verdict.rationale: Ari is a built-in AI assistant. Users ask it financial questions, have it rebuild a workbook as a live Model, request scenarios in one line, ask it to add or remove synced tables, and let it keep the model current, with proactive alerts and a drafted board deck. Delegation is backed by a per-tool allow/ask/deny policy with human approval, and every write is undoable. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Ari performs these delegated tasks reliably, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
